contents.title: The solid-state propulsion cell
contents.description: Our primary breakthrough consolidates atmospheric ionization and momentum transfer into a single monolithic solid-state cell, eliminating turbines and mechanical friction entirely.

contents.title: Asymmetric dielectric ionization
contents.description: By shaping micro-scale electrode geometry, the emitter generates a localized corona discharge that accelerates surrounding atmospheric ions at near-zero thermal loss.

contents.title: Empirical chamber verification
contents.description: Rigorous benchtop vacuum and pressure chamber testing demonstrates continuous acoustic emissions below 12 dB with sub-micron drift stability across 480 continuous operational hours.

contents.title: Stratospheric surveillance envelope
contents.description: Designed for autonomous stratospheric lingering, the cell enables silent long-duration wildfire surveillance and atmospheric climate sensing with zero fossil fuel burn.

contents.title: Monolithic scalable production
contents.description: Standard PCB lithography and additive carbon-composite layups bring the bill of materials down to $180 per unit compared to $24,000 for legacy mechanical small-scale turbo-fan drones.

contents.title: High-voltage solid-state power stage
contents.description: Gallium nitride (GaN) switching topology converts 24V bus power to 38kV micro-pulses at 98.4% power efficiency with active thermal spreading.

contents.title: Aero-ionic boundary layer control
contents.description: Electro-hydrodynamic shear flow eliminates boundary layer separation along the airfoil surface, delaying stall by 34% in low-Reynolds stratospheric regimes.

contents.title: Autonomous avionics telemetry array
contents.description: Integrated dual-redundant flight computer monitors ion current densities across 64 individual emitter sectors with real-time impedance tracking.

contents.title: Closed-loop feedback sensor mesh
contents.description: Embedded capacitive probe arrays sense atmospheric humidity and density fluctuations, adjusting voltage curves dynamically in under 2 milliseconds.

contents.title: Multi-cell modular thrust vectoring
contents.description: Differential voltage modulation between quadrant emitter channels produces agile roll, pitch, and yaw control without any mechanical ailerons or servos.
